Explore Our ProductsAbout Our Factory

A cashew factory in Chandgad

Jai Hind Agro Cashew Industries is a cashew processing factory at Millatnagar, Chandgad, Kolhapur, Maharashtra. It started in 2015.

We focus on careful processing and quality checking, so our customers get cashews they can rely on.

  • Wholesale orders accepted
  • Supply across the local area, Maharashtra and India
  • Serving shops, wholesalers, hotels, restaurants and food businesses
